title: Types of Sharks
desc: Eighteen kinds of sharks, picture and name first — great white, hammerhead, whale shark and more. A facts deck (one true fact per shark) waits as Stage 2, ready to turn on later.

cards.name: Great White Shark
cards.def: It has about 300 sharp teeth, and new ones keep growing in. It hunts seals.

cards.name: Hammerhead Shark
cards.def: Its wide, flat head is shaped like a hammer. The great hammerhead uses its head to pin down stingrays.

cards.name: Tiger Shark
cards.def: Young tiger sharks have dark stripes like a tiger. It eats almost anything — even tires and license plates!

cards.name: Bull Shark
cards.def: It can swim from the salty sea into freshwater rivers — one went 700 miles up the Mississippi River!

cards.name: Mako Shark
cards.def: The fastest shark in the sea! It can leap high out of the water.

cards.name: Whale Shark
cards.def: The biggest fish in the world — it can grow longer than a school bus! It eats tiny plankton.

cards.name: Basking Shark
cards.def: The second-biggest fish in the world. It has a giant mouth for catching tiny plankton.

cards.name: Blue Shark
cards.def: Its back is deep blue. It swims very far — from New England all the way to South America.

cards.name: Lemon Shark
cards.def: Its skin is yellowish, like a lemon. The color helps it hide over the sandy sea floor.

cards.name: Thresher Shark
cards.def: Its tail can be as long as its body! It whips its tail to stun the fish it eats.

cards.name: Blacktip Reef Shark
cards.def: The tips of its fins look dipped in black paint. It swims in shallow water near coral reefs.

cards.name: Leopard Shark
cards.def: It has dark spots like a leopard. It swims near the shore from Oregon down to Mexico.

cards.name: Nurse Shark
cards.def: It rests in the daytime and hunts at night on the sea floor, sucking up food like a vacuum.

cards.name: Zebra Shark
cards.def: Baby zebra sharks have stripes like a zebra, but grown-ups have spots!

cards.name: Wobbegong
cards.def: Its pattern looks like a carpet. It lies still on the sea floor and waits for fish to come close.

cards.name: Angel Shark
cards.def: It is flat like a pancake. It buries itself in the sand and waits to grab fish.

cards.name: Goblin Shark
cards.def: It lives deep in the ocean and has pink skin. Its jaws shoot forward to snatch food.

cards.name: Greenland Shark
cards.def: It swims very slowly in icy water and can live for hundreds of years — longer than any other animal with a backbone.
